_notes: Source: the town's own OFFICIAL BALLOT for the annual town election with the Town Clerk's counts written on it, marked "POSTED 5/25/2021" and "81 Voters", still served from the town's WordPress media library. Two races were genuinely contested: Selectmen (Jayko 49 / Trottier 30) and Town Clerk (Supranowicz 43 / Trottier 37). The ballot also carried a question -- shall the elected Town Clerk become appointed -- Yes 44 / No 36, which is outside the parse spec. The Cemetery Committee write-in line is annotated "Undetermined" by the clerk and is not carried. No blanks are recorded, so 81 is a ceiling and no race closes against it. The date is PRINTED ON THE DOCUMENT: "ANNUAL TOWN ELECTION NEW ASHFORD, MASSACHUSETTS MAY 25, 2021". INDEPENDENTLY CORROBORATED: the Berkshire Eagle, 27 May 2021, "Former town clerk loses two races in New Ashford election" (Scott Stafford) reports every figure on this ballot and all NINE match -- Jayko 49 / Trottier 30, Supranowicz 43 / Trottier 37, Frye 67, George 64, Haig Jr. 68, Singer 61, Bossana 56 -- plus the ballot question at 44 to 36. THE FOURTH CEMETERY COMMITTEE SEAT WAS NOT FILLED: the article says "There were three candidates running for four, one-year terms", which is why the ballot's write-in line for that race is annotated "Undetermined" by the clerk. num_winners=4 records the seats up; only three were filled.
